Managed by: Kai Bhaskarrao Mahajan Samajik, Shaikshnik Va Sanskrutik Sanstha
Institution: Indala College of Engineering (also presented on the official website as Indala College of Engineering &
Polytechnic).
Approvals / affiliation stated by the institution: Approved by AICTE and DTE, Government of Maharashtra; affiliated to the
University of Mumbai. Polytechnic programmes are listed separately under MSBTE.
About the College
Indala College of Engineering is located at Bapsai on Kalyan–Murbad Road, Taluka Kalyan, District Thane. It offers
undergraduate engineering programmes and promotes practical learning through laboratories, technical activities, internships
and industry interaction.

3. Admission Process
First Year Engineering – general CAP route
1. Appear for the applicable entrance examination (normally MHT-CET; other eligible routes follow the current admission
brochure).
2. Register online on the Maharashtra State CET Cell portal when CAP registration opens.
3. Complete the application and document verification.
4. Check provisional/final merit lists and resolve discrepancies within the notified schedule.
5. Fill and confirm the option form, listing Indala College and preferred branches in order.
6. Check seat allotment. If allotted, accept the seat and report to the institute within the deadline with original documents and
fee payment.
7. Complete institute admission formalities and collect the confirmation/receipt.
Direct Second Year (DSE)
Eligible Diploma/B.Sc. candidates must register for the separate DSE process on the State CET Cell portal, complete
document verification, check the merit lis

Diploma/B.Sc. candidates must register for the separate DSE process on the State CET Cell portal, complete
document verification, check the merit list, fill the option form, and follow the allotment and reporting schedule. The college
states DSE admissions are handled by the State CET Cell and there are no institutional-quota admissions for DSE.
Against-CAP vacancies
If seats remain vacant after CAP rounds, check college and CET Cell notices for the vacancy-round procedure. Confirm the
process and official receipt directly with the college.

6. Scholarships & Financial Assistance
The college lists merit-based awards, need-based assistance for eligible economically weaker students, government
scholarships / fee reimbursements under State CET Cell and DTE rules, and institution-level support subject to approval each
academic year. Students should check MahaDBT and the college scholarship office for scheme eligibility, deadlines and
required certificates.
